Class newBasket

java.lang.Object
Users.newBasket
public class newBasket extends Object
Represents a shopping basket that can hold both BoardGame and Accessory products (or any other Product subtype). The basket tracks each distinct product together with the quantity of that product currently placed in the basket.

  • Method Details

    • addShopping

      public newBasket.AddResult addShopping(int pid, int amount)
      Adds amount units of product to the basket.

      If the product is not already in the basket, it is added with its amount set to amount (as long as stock allows it). If the product is already in the basket, amount is added to its current basket quantity.

      If the resulting total quantity for that product exceeds the product's quantityInStock, the whole operation is cancelled and the basket is left unchanged.

      Parameters:
      pid - the ID for the product to add
      amount - how many units to add
      Returns:
      what happened, so the caller can report it to the user
